This '''individual''' served as the first mate on the ''[[Oroko]]'', [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and gangster [[Valius Ying]]. In [[3964 BBY]], [[Marn Hierogryph]] bribed this person to release the [[junk hauler]] [[The Last Resort (starship)|''Last Resort'']] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], allowing for the rescue of his friend [[Zayne Carrick]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
